abstract: We develop a methodology for set-based state estimation from noisy input-output trajectories, without a predefined model structure for the unknown state dynamics or access to training state measurements. We derive a bound on the state set diameter that depends on the sensor map and leverage it as a surrogate to formulate a tractable linear program balancing state set tightness against output trajectory coverage. Combining this certificate with deterministic or probabilistically certified measurement noise sets and leveraging the results from scenario optimization with relaxation, we provide joint a posteriori probabilistic guarantees for state inclusion and state set diameter. Numerical simulations corroborate our developed theoretical guarantees.

title: Set-based State Estimation for Unknown Dynamical Systems from Noisy Output Data with Probabilistic Guarantees
